context.narrative: 阴湿的维修通道里散落着破损的医疗废料，消毒水混着铁锈的腐臭往人鼻子里钻，应急灯滋滋闪着，水滴砸在铁皮地面上的回声在空管道里撞得人耳膜发疼。李昂贴着墙根挪到冷藏样本库的后门时，先扫了眼监控的覆盖盲区，刚要示意克莱尔跟上，就发现库门半掩着，里面摆着贴满生化警示标的空货架，半片样本盒的影子都没见着。
shot_prompts:
A tense survival horror scene in a damp maintenance corridor of an Umbrella Corporation facility. Water drips from rusted pipes, creating a foul mix of disinfectant and iron rust smell. Emergency lights flicker with a buzzing sound, casting harsh shadows. Leon Kennedy, wearing his RPD uniform with rain and grime, crouches low against the wall, checking a monitor panel. Next to him, Claire Redfield in her red motorcycle jacket, looking alert and ready. They approach the rear door of the cold storage sample library. The door is half-open, revealing empty shelves coated in biohazard stickers. Half-empty sample boxes sit forlornly on the metal racks, undisturbed dust gathering. The atmosphere is heavy with dread and suspense.
